purpose: Explain locally observed Tesla Fleet traffic, current and prior fixed UTC cycles, estimated spend, and independently selected historical costs without implying an invoice.
primaryGoal: Understand observed usage and category costs, inspect historical distribution and trends, export the selected evidence, and reach API logs while retaining estimate limitations.

dataSources.name: useTeslaUsage
dataSources.behavior: Query key system-status/api-usage; five-minute refetch, forwarded AbortSignal, finite-number cycle validation, non-retryable TeslaUsageContractError and fewer than three retries for other errors. Requires current, history array, rate_source and disclaimer. Page passes retained cycle payload through useDataState; current/prior cycles remain independent of historical selection.
dataSources.verification: Endpoint registration source-matched; mounted traffic, backend aggregation, deduplication and billing accuracy unverified. Backend handler/database implementation not inspected.

dataSources.name: useTeslaUsageHistory
dataSources.behavior: Independent query key includes both bounds and bucket; five-minute polling, AbortSignal and same contract-error retry policy. Initial inclusive UTC civil range is today minus 29 days through today; conversion produces [start,end) with one-day exclusive upper-bound adjustment, validates actual civil dates, ordering and maximum 366 days. Invalid bounds disable the request. Sparse points remain sparse; category USD is locally derived using 150000/1000/500/50 events per USD, while headline estimate uses source estimated_usd.
dataSources.verification: Frontend bounds and route registration inspected; server bound enforcement, weekly Monday alignment and actual payloads unverified.

dataSources.name: Formatting and operational evidence
dataSources.behavior: Existing useOperationalMetrics bridge, useFormatting currency renderer and useNumberFormatting counts; no new unit engine. Explicit unknown observation-time message, loading/available/retained source labels and unscored confidence. Raw numeric counts and USD remain unchanged; currency conversion semantics in formatting hooks were not traced.
dataSources.verification: Source composition inspected; saved preferences and actual currency/locale rendering unverified.

states.initialLoading: Current cycle renders summary and localized loading message without hiding history or methodology. History summary receives loading and both charts receive loading; no whole-page data gate.
states.empty: Current absence renders unavailable copy; no prior cycles renders a specific list item. History points default to []; no observed traffic produces range guidance and chart emptiness. Zero estimated total makes the distribution empty while observed time-series points remain available.
states.error: Contract mismatch gives explicit upgrade guidance; current fatal failure is text-only and has no inline retry action. Chart frames offer historical refetch. Invalid range disables fetch but passes a no-op retry callback. Existing retry policy avoids repeated incompatible payload requests.
states.staleOffline: Current query uses useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning while retaining data. History only reads data/isLoading/error/refetch: summary labels retained after errors, but chart error prop replaces retained plots and disables exports. Fetch-pause/offline and freshness are not separately consumed by this history component.
states.successDisabled: Day/week selection, selected totals, sparse series and exports are available on successful history. Invalid bounds disable the historical request. Chart export controls are disabled/hidden for loading/error/empty by existing owner; no mutations on this page.

issues.detail: Both chart frames receive raw refresh error even with retained totals/points. ChartContainer prioritizes error over children at 699-705 and disables controls at 428-429; retained historical plots and exports disappear while summary still shows retained data.
issues.fix: Use the existing useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning/SourceContent pattern; pass fatalError only to the frame, retain usable plots and export scope on refresh failure, and expose source retry/freshness/offline state.

issues.detail: Missing totals produce four synthetic zero category USD rows. ChartContainer renders fallback data tables whenever nonempty data/dataColumns exist (448-453,791-850), regardless of loading/error; the supplied formatter also maps non-number cells to zero at 143.
issues.fix: Provide absent or explicitly unknown distribution evidence when totals are unavailable and preserve valid measured zero; format missing cells as unknown, never fabricated currency zero.

issues.detail: Fatal cycle failure asks the user to refresh but exposes no current-cycle retry action; history retry cannot retry the independent cycle query.
issues.fix: Pass the existing cycle refetch callback to shared source recovery at the page boundary, preserving upgrade guidance, independent history and method content.

visualIssues.detail: Mounted top lists use fixed-white background tint, per-element text-xs/tracking classes and monospace truncation for explanatory prose. Footer at 357-359 uses hardcoded cyan and white hover decoration rather than canonical theme-aware action chrome. The page itself uses role typography and has no direct neon/glow styling.
visualIssues.fix: Modernize the existing UsageCard owner with neutral surface tokens, role typography and canonical navigation classes; keep semantic warning hues and all explanatory content. Do not add another spend card or reset selected chart colors.

architectureIssues.detail: getWorkspaceRouteScope returns vehicle=true for this route because it is not in VEHICLE_DISABLED_PATHS or disabled prefixes, yet neither page hook accepts selected vehicle. RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS at 23 also omits it, while history explicitly owns a local range.
architectureIssues.fix: Have the existing workspace integration owner disable misleading vehicle scope for this fleet-wide usage surface and reconcile historical range with header ownership; no fabricated vehicle filtering or second scope store.

architectureIssues.detail: Category costs and displayed pricing are fixed client ratios; APIUsage supplies rate_source/disclaimer but no per-category rate contract. API disclaimer is validated yet displayed explanations use localized local text. No source inspection establishes equivalence to every backend pricing adjustment.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current math, original source fields, total estimated_usd and all caveats; verify pricing and disclaimer semantics with existing backend owner before changing derivation or claiming invoice equivalence. Do not invent a rates endpoint.
